metadata.title: These were the only stocks that rose amid the stock market’s wipeout Thursday - MarketWatch

content.text:
Deep Dive
These were the only stocks that rose amid the stock market’s wipeout Thursday
All 11 sectors of the S&P 500 declined — 10 of them by more than 1% — but cybersecurity stocks bucked the weakness
Only 38 stocks among the S&P 500 rose on Thursday amid a broad decline across the major U.S. indexes, as the successful completion of Anthropic’s record initial public offering sucked the wind out of the market.
The stock market opened broadly higher, as strong demand for Anthropic’s ANT IPO gave investors reason to be optimistic. But just as the artificial-intelligence giant’s stock soared out of the gate, the market started sinking, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, the S&P 500 SPX and the Nasdaq Composite COMP all fell more than 2%.
